scope: Rehearsal runtimes ulpin-reh-NN only; never the demo. Approved by the owner on 27 Oct: the runner answers GeoJSON layout questions as the officer, from answers the lead wrote from each file's own field names.

answers.basis: The issuer's layer is Building Footprints 2018; each Feature is one footprint polygon. OBJECTID is the issuer's whole-number object id, present on every sampled feature. No property names a building, so the name stays not stated.

Halifax Regional Municipality Buildings layer; each Feature has FCODE BLDG. BL_ID is the issuer's building identifier (text such as BL156297); OBJECTID is only a row number. No property names a building, so the name stays not stated. BL_ID is null in 26,493 of 172,409 features and repeats in 4,156 groups (S3.11d), so it cannot key each building. BLPOLY_ID, the issuer's building polygon identifier, is present, text and distinct in all 172,409 features (lead check, 28 Oct); GLOBALID is a system GUID.
